annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation binds persons and organisations involved in civil aviation (including operators of unmanned aircraft, designers and producers of aircraft and parts), Member States, their competent authorities, and the Agency and Commission.

annotation.robot_provision_quote: this Regulation should cover unmanned aircraft, regardless of their operating mass.
